reports.title: Revenue
reports.query:
MATCH (rg:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(co:Country)<-[:IN_COUNTRY]-(:City)<-[:LIVES_IN]-(cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
  AND (coalesce($neodash_region_name, '') = '' OR rg.name = $neodash_region_name)
  AND ($neodash_from_date IS NULL OR $neodash_from_date = '' OR o.date >= $neodash_from_date)
  AND ($neodash_to_date IS NULL OR $neodash_to_date = '' OR o.date <= $neodash_to_date)
RETURN toInteger(sum(o.total)) AS Revenue

reports.title: Revenue by category and region
reports.query:
MATCH (rg:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(co:Country)<-[:IN_COUNTRY]-(:City)<-[:LIVES_IN]-(cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
  AND (coalesce($neodash_region_name, '') = '' OR rg.name = $neodash_region_name)
  AND ($neodash_from_date IS NULL OR $neodash_from_date = '' OR o.date >= $neodash_from_date)
  AND ($neodash_to_date IS NULL OR $neodash_to_date = '' OR o.date <= $neodash_to_date)
MATCH (o)-[c:CONTAINS]->(:Product)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(:Category)-[:SUBCATEGORY_OF]->(top:Category)
RETURN top.name AS Category, rg.name AS Region, toInteger(sum(c.quantity * c.unitPrice)) AS Revenue
ORDER BY Category

reports.title: Top products
reports.query:
MATCH (rg:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(co:Country)<-[:IN_COUNTRY]-(:City)<-[:LIVES_IN]-(cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
  AND (coalesce($neodash_region_name, '') = '' OR rg.name = $neodash_region_name)
  AND ($neodash_from_date IS NULL OR $neodash_from_date = '' OR o.date >= $neodash_from_date)
  AND ($neodash_to_date IS NULL OR $neodash_to_date = '' OR o.date <= $neodash_to_date)
MATCH (o)-[c:CONTAINS]->(p:Product)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(sub:Category)
WITH p, sub, sum(c.quantity) AS units, sum(c.quantity * c.unitPrice) AS revenue, sum(c.quantity * p.cost) AS cost
RETURN p.name AS Product, sub.name AS Category, units AS Units, toInteger(revenue) AS Revenue,
       round(100.0 * (revenue - cost) / revenue, 1) AS `Margin %`
ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 15

reports.title: Top customers
reports.query:
MATCH (rg:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(co:Country)<-[:IN_COUNTRY]-(:City)<-[:LIVES_IN]-(cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
  AND (coalesce($neodash_region_name, '') = '' OR rg.name = $neodash_region_name)
  AND ($neodash_from_date IS NULL OR $neodash_from_date = '' OR o.date >= $neodash_from_date)
  AND ($neodash_to_date IS NULL OR $neodash_to_date = '' OR o.date <= $neodash_to_date)
RETURN cu.name AS Customer, cu.segment AS Segment, co.name AS Country, count(o) AS Orders, toInteger(sum(o.total)) AS Revenue
ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 15

reports.title: Recent orders
reports.query:
MATCH (cu:Customer {name: $neodash_customer_name})-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)
WITH cu, o ORDER BY o.date DESC LIMIT 8
MATCH path = (cu)-[:PLACED]->(o)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Product)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(:Category)
RETURN path

reports.title: Order history
reports.query:
MATCH (cu:Customer {name: $neodash_customer_name})-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_FROM]->(w:Warehouse)
RETURN o.id AS Order, o.date AS Date, o.status AS Status, o.channel AS Channel, o.total AS Total, w.name AS Warehouse
ORDER BY Date DESC
